visual_observations: Longitudinal timber grain, cross-beam grain and end-grain visible.
Weathered masonry joints and foot grime visible in game.
Metal, colored stone and crystal stages render with distinct material finishes.
Raised wall silhouettes remain within the original 4x4 ground grid.
limitations: First batch captured in preparation phase; later batches include a postgame banner obscuring part of the upper silhouette.
No claim of manual selection / upgrade testing for all 30 levels.
Full construction reveal timing was not tested per model; matching shell geometry and lifecycle covered by asset audit and regression.
